title: Chapter 534
text:
At the dock square, many wanderers and galactic pirates that had stayed on Floating Dragon surrounded the BlackLight Stealth, pointing at it with envy and greed in their eyes.
A spaceship from the Federation of Light, a high-end product!
It was a pity that this expensive spaceship was Black Star's. On Floating Dragon, not many people dared to mess around, and they only dared to look at it.
"Move."
Han Xiao's voice sounded from outside the crowd, and the hundreds of people surrounding the spaceship turned around. Their faces turned pale, and they hurriedly took a few steps back as though they had seen a ghost. Their eyes then landed on the tall lady beside Han Xiao, the owner of this floating island.
"It's the Dragon Emperor!"
Everyone broke out in a cold sweat. It was rare for outsiders to see Ames with their own eyes. Thinking about her strength and identity, these villains could not help but feel their legs turn to jelly, and they felt immense pressure.
The two of them did not even look at this group of people and walked side by side, passing through the crowd, stepping onto the gangway, and entering the spaceship.
Hu
The BlackLight Stealth quickly took off, turning into a stream of light and disappearing into the vast universe.
Everyone stared blankly as Ames followed Han Xiao into the spaceship. Only after the spaceship left did they regain their senses, and a commotion broke out.
"The Dragon Emperor is out again!"
"This time, she's actually together with Black Star. He's the leader of the Field Team. Is Ames going to do something?"
"Black Star just arrived, and Ames left with him right after. I have a feeling that something big is going to happen!"
Ames' position was extremely high, and her every action would cause all kinds of guesses. These people that were docked on Floating Dragon were all well-informed people, and it was not hard to imagine that this news would quickly spread to the various organizations in the galaxy.
However, for now, the news first spread on a large scale on Floating Dragon, causing even more people to be surprised, and it soon reached Jenny's ears.
Jenny was dumbfounded.
The moment she heard this news, she felt like she was about to collapse.
Ames had always gone out to play, but she had always left alone. This time, it was different. She actually left with Black Star?
What exactly did Black Star say to Ames!
Jenny was so angry that her lips were trembling. Black Star was now full of controversy, and she could already foresee that in the future, all kinds of trouble would come one after another, and the matters that she had to deal with would double!
However, Ames was her boss. In the past, she could still make things difficult for Black Star, but now that her boss was personally causing trouble, what else could she do? Who could she reason with?
The corners of Jenny's eyes twitched, and her crow's feet almost squeezed out.
So f * cking desperate!
The spaceship that had entered hyperdrive turned on autopilot. Han Xiao stood up from the pilot's seat and turned to look at Ames.
"It will take about ten days to return to Planet Aquamarine, and there are only the two of us on the spaceship. If you don't want to sleep, I'm happy to accompany you to kill time."
"This spaceship is not bad."
Ames looked around and sized up the spaceship. Then, her gaze landed on Han Xiao's face, and she smiled. "Is there anything to drink?"
The two of them came to the resting hall, and Ames sat down lazily on the sofa with her long legs crossed. She supported her head with her left hand and did not care about showing off her seductive figure in front of others. She liked to maintain a position that made her comfortable.
Han Xiao opened the food cabinet, easily pried open the compartment, and took out a bottle of good wine that Herlous had hidden inside. He then took out two cups, placed them on the coffee table in front of Ames, and filled the two cups. He then picked up his own cup and sat opposite Ames.
Ames curled her finger, and the wine cup on the table was grabbed by her force field, flying to her mouth steadily. She took a small sip, smiled, and said, "It tastes terrible."
"Is that so? I think it's okay." Han Xiao's mouth twitched. Herlous was not a human, after all, so his taste buds were probably a little different.
Ames blinked, smiled, and said, "Let's talk about yourself. Ever since you joined Floating Dragon, I haven't gotten to know you properly."
In Noriosse, Han Xiao had helped her capture Aesop, and Ames was very grateful. She was not the kind of person who felt that it was normal for her subordinates to do things for her. Compared to the other three super strong people in the Shattered Star Ring, she was very casual.
A few years ago, she did not pay much attention to Han Xiao and only casually allowed him to join Floating Dragon because of Aesop. However, in just a few years, not only did Black Star gradually gain a foothold, his strength had also increased rapidly. Although it was still not much compared to her, the speed of his growth surprised her.
Ames could not help but be interested in this officer under her command. Only then did she realize that her understanding of Han Xiao was almost zero.
Hearing that, Han Xiao casually talked about his origins and naturally left out the information about the players. He started from the Germinal Organization test subjects, then talked about the 'Inhumans' from the perspective of the Planet Aquamarine people, and then talked about his officers. Ames listened attentively.
After talking for a long time, Han Xiao finally stopped and drank a mouthful of wine to moisten his throat. He was not against telling stories. This was a rare opportunity to be alone with Ames, and it was a good opportunity to get closer to her. Furthermore, Ames was a great beauty, and with Han Xiao's current strength, he would naturally not be swayed by her. However, it was still quite pleasing to the eye.
At the very least, it was much better than the hairy and muscular Harmon.
After listening to Han Xiao's story, Ames lightly tapped her thigh with a thoughtful expression. "A pair of sisters who control life and death respectively. I think I've heard of them somewhere before."
She was not concerned about politics, countries, or civilizations. Instead, it was the situation of Hila and Aurora that attracted her attention.
Han Xiao did not hide the story of Hila and Aurora. In his previous life, Hila, who embraced darkness, was even more intimidating than Ames when she was at her peak. However, Hila was still very weak now. However, there seemed to be something strange about this. Ames would usually not pay attention to what happened on a barbarian planet. If she had heard of such a situation, it would definitely have come from a very high level.
"You said that Aroshia is a life form. Then, are the millions of similar Space Wonders the same principle?"
Han Xiao shook his head and pretended to hesitate. "It should be different."
As soon as he said that, a change suddenly occurred in the resting hall.
Hum …
Streams of light suddenly condensed into a human figure. Risda appeared and sat beside Han Xiao.
"Why did you come out?" Han Xiao asked.
Ames' gaze also turned to Risda with a curious look on her face.
Risda slowly stood up and bowed deeply toward Ames. His tone was sincere and urgent, and there was even a hint of begging in it.
"Your Majesty, I hope to beg you for one thing. I beg you to help my civilization and save my people! I am willing to pay the price and be at your beck and call forever! "
Earlier, Han Xiao had also mentioned the situation of the Life Civilization. Risda knew that Ames was a bigshot, and her strength was on the same level as that Mechanic who had occupied his people. She had the ability to deal with that person.
This was a chance to ask for help. Even if the chance of the Dragon Emperor agreeing was only one in ten thousand, Risda was not willing to give up. If Ames was willing to help, everything would become simple. This seemingly impossible task would have hope of succeeding.
"Fight?" Ames raised an eyebrow. "Who are you talking about?"
"He was a Mechanic. He stole my home, enslaved almost all of my people, and turned them into his weapons. I will never forget his name. He was called Manison the Ancient One Papaki!"
"Oh, so it's the Mechanic Emperor of the Primeval Star River. He is a member of the Ancient Ones." Ames shook her head. "I reject your request."
The Primeval Star River was a large Star Field like the Shattered Star Ring. The position of the Mechanic Emperor there was similar to the position of the Dragon Emperor Ames in the Shattered Star Ring.
The 'Ancient Ones' was a special organization, and Ames' adoptive father, Aesop, was once a member of the 'Ancient Ones'. However, he had left the group.
Although Risda was mentally prepared, he was still very disappointed. He asked, "May I know the reason for your rejection?"
Ames did not seem to mind. "I can't defeat him."
Risda's figure flickered as though he was shocked. "Even … even you are not his match?"
Han Xiao did not say anything. He was not surprised by this. Super was a general classification, and there were naturally strong and weak. Ames was very strong, but she was not invincible. Ames had never felt that she was invincible.
Ten days passed in a flash. There was not much to do on the spaceship, so Han Xiao chatted with Ames every day. Their relationship had become much closer, and the atmosphere was much more natural.
Planet Aquamarine appeared outside the porthole, and numerous Godoran frigates were guarding the atmosphere. Upon noticing the BlackLight Stealth approaching, they immediately sent out a warning.
"Visitor, please verify your identity!"
"It's me," Han Xiao replied in the channel.
"Black Star, you can land now." The other party's tone softened. Although Godora was currently in a crisis and they had to be careful, Han Xiao had fought alongside them in the past and had proven that he was not an enemy.
After passing through, the BlackLight Stealth landed in the Sanctuary. Looking down at the Sanctuary, the number of refugees seemed to have increased. Most of them were wearing restraints. In the period that Han Xiao was not around, many dangers had occurred on Planet Aquamarine, but they were all resolved. The players had done many things and lived a very fulfilling life.
DarkStar did not attack the calamity planets but instead went to harass the other colonies. This made the situation even more tense, and Godora was in a terrible predicament. However, this did not affect Han Xiao.
The hatch opened, and Ames floated out. She looked around and said, "Is this your homeworld? That's great. It's a pity that my homeworld has become an abandoned planet."
"Most of the Inhumans are at the square. I have something to take care of first," Han Xiao said.
Ames nodded and floated to the square alone, curiously looking at the players coming and going.
A passing player subconsciously turned his head to look, and he was stunned. His mouth was wide open, and his face was blank.
"Aiaiaiaiai Ames?!"
"You know me?"
Ames was surprised. She had thought that these Inhumans were natives and had not expected them to know her.
More and more people noticed Ames, and all the players fell into a state of shock.
The originally noisy square seemed to have been cast with some kind of magic, and with Ames at the center, the 'magic' spread out continuously. The entire square gradually quietened down, and like a spring that had been pressed to the bottom, a certain emotion was brewing.
Boom!
The next moment, the exclamations of countless players rang out, resounding through the clouds!
On the other side, Han Xiao did not leave with Ames. Instead, he quickly arrived at the Godoran camp and requested to meet with Nagakin.
The Godoran guard at the gate shook his head, and his reply was no different from half a month ago. "Black Star, His Excellency Nagakin is currently participating in an emergency meeting and does not have the time to meet you. Please return."
Han Xiao had a clear goal this time, and with a deep voice, he said, "Go and tell him that I have a new Mutation Source in my hands! I don't care what he is doing; I want him to meet me immediately! "
The guard's expression changed, and he did not dare make a decision on his own. He immediately reported to Nagakin.
After waiting for less than two minutes at the gate, a streak of golden light shot out from the depths of the Godoran camp and stopped in front of him. Wherever the streak of golden light passed, a hole would be left in the building, and a long gash would be left on the ground. It was Nagakin.
When Nagakin heard the reason for Han Xiao's visit, he was so shocked that he almost fell off his chair. How could he care about the meeting anymore? He could not even be bothered to walk and rushed out to welcome Han Xiao.
"Is … is what you said for real?"
Nagakin had a nervous expression on his face.
Han Xiao took out the Mutation Source, which was sealed in a transparent sphere, and it attracted Nagakin's gaze like a magnet.
"Let's talk inside."
Han Xiao waved his hands to block Nagakin's line of sight and chuckled.
